theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rh_mc_exists_c1_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∃ (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (φ : ℕ → Euclidean N → ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ (∀ y ∉ K, g y = 0) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ y ∉ K, φ k y = 0) ∧ (∀ ε > 0, ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ y, |φ k y - g y| ≤ ε)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
